Body.Content:
Journal line improvements in Dynamics 365 Project Operations simplifies journal entry with a Quick create dialog that displays fields relevant to the selected transaction class and transaction type. For example, role information appears for time entries, while product information appears for material entries.

Automatic defaults populate related values where available and use the transaction date to fill supporting dates, including document, start, end, and accounting dates. For entries that use the Fixed Price amount method, quantity defaults to one and price is set to the entered amount.

Business rules validate combinations of billing method, transaction type, and transaction class when journal lines are created or updated, including through imports and integrations. These checks help prevent unsupported entries regardless of how journal data is entered.

More info: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/project-operations/actuals/journal-line-improvements

GA date: November CY2026
